constraints.description: A successfully reconnected MCP transport and its authoritative configuration are shared by later independent filtered and pre-existing merged registry views without a UAR restart or stale-config rollback after upsert.

validation.validation_method: Focused exact registry tests including A-to-B upsert then crash/reconnect, plus installed echo-crash-echo process trace

constraints.description: Crash and timeout operations each emit exactly one explicit failed tool-result event, execute exactly once at the MCP process boundary, and are not replayed during reconnect.

validation.validation_method: Raw crash and timeout SSE replay against the exact process trace plus six synthetic negative controls

constraints.description: Sharing replacement transport state does not add excluded servers, MCP tools, or native tools to any registry view.

validation.validation_method: Focused filtered and merged registry authorization assertions

constraints.description: The retained raw evidence and summary bind to source f0298d76ea3c39853020c8a33e13f136c07a1806 and replay with matching hashes and exact candidate identity.

validation.validation_method: Source SHA, candidate tag, byte comparison, SHA-256 receipts, raw parser replay, and referenced-file checks

constraints.description: Verification reports actual commands, outputs, warnings, negative controls, and limits without claiming the parent three-hour soak, GA readiness, deployment success, or another runtime profile.

validation.validation_method: Verification-row audit, strict child and parent OpenSpec validation, GitHub Actions policy validation, scoped diff check, and history-free review

global_rules: Use the child OpenSpec proposal, design, specification, tasks, KBD scope, and immutable source commit as acceptance authority.
Do not replay a failed MCP operation whose completion is uncertain.
Do not widen per-view server or tool authorization while sharing transport state.
Run product and release verification locally; GitHub Actions remain deployment-only.
Exclude operator settings, generated static output, prior screen evidence, unrelated KBD projections, and parent certification evidence from the child commit.
termination_conditions: Manifest, constraints, state, checkpoint, reference, hash, raw-evidence, strict OpenSpec, and scoped diff checks pass.
History-free artifact critic and independent judge find no implementation, scope, or evidence blocker.
